name: Five Hourly Jobs to Move to AI First
description_md:
Turn five document-heavy jobs into a first pass you can check.

- Five copy-ready prompts for contracts, vendor terms, policies, evidence and invoices.

- The inputs to attach and human checks for each job.

- A simple trial that counts review time as well as AI cost.

3-page PDF + plain-text prompts. Free download. Legal and compliance decisions stay with a qualified reviewer.
